blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The heat index in Talisay, Batangas reached 41 degrees Celsius, while Calamba City, Laguna, registered 40 degrees Celsius on Thursday, Oct. 22. To help residents cope with the prevailing heat, the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction Management Council (MDRRMC) in Talisay advised them to take precautionary measures in a Facebook post at 2:45 p.m. READ: Super El Niño demands urgent, science-based governance In an advisory, the Calamba City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) said the heat index reached 40°C at 1:30 p.m., up from 39°C recorded at 10:30 a.m. Heat index values typically peak from midday through […]...
